Five colleagues — Anil, Bhavna, Chirag, Divya and Esha — each give exactly one presentation, one per day from Monday to Friday. Use the clues below.

- Divya presents on an earlier day than Chirag.
- Esha presents on an earlier day than Anil.
- Esha presents on the day immediately before Divya.
- Anil presents neither on Monday nor on Friday.
- Esha presents neither on Monday nor on Friday.
